articles.summary: Hope Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: HOPE) today announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Bank of Hope (“the Bank”), has completed its previously announced acquisition of the Commercial Banking Unit of SMBC MANUBANK (“MANUBANK”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of SMBC Americas Holdings, Inc. and Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (“SMBC”). The acquisition adds an established commercial banking franchise and seasoned professionals to Bank of Hope, diversifying its deposit segments and expanding its footprint and client base in the Greater Los Angeles market. The transaction also reinforces the Bank’s position as a premier financial partner to middle-market businesses and deepens its relationships across the Korean and Japanese business communities. “The completion of this transaction represents an important milestone in the continued evolution of Bank of Hope,” said Kevin S. articles.title: Bank of Hope Completes Acquisition of the Commercial Banking Unit of SMBC MANUBANK
